description:
Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m)

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team.

Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools

  • Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review

  • Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships

  • Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth

  • Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team

 

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers

  • You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind

  • You are comfortable coding, with the help of AI agents like Claude Code, in multiple languages and eager to learn our tech stack

  • You are in your final year of a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and looking for a 6-month full-time internship

  • Eager to learn and work in a team of builders

  • You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with web development or building products in a fast-paced environment

  • Have worked on side projects or contributed to open-source communities

  • Are familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and eager to integrate them into your daily workflow.

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib if you work from the office or in a hybrid setup.

  • Company health insurance with excellent additional benefits.

  • Free mental health and coaching sessions provided through an external partner.

  • In addition to healthy snacks and a regular breakfast buffet, we offer meal vouchers.

  • A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club.

  • Tech masterclasses throughout the internship.

  • Free breakfast at the office.

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding and development, as well as dedicated training.

 

Our interview process

  • Coding Game (1h)

  • Recruiter Interview (30 minutes)

  • Feature Building Interview (1h)

  • Behavioral Interview (1h)

Job details

  • Internship (6 months)

  • Berlin 

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: March 2027

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

description:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Köln zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Als B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Franken für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

  • Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

  • Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

  • Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im Außendienst mit – idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Franken (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

  • Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Unser Doctolib Parent Care Programm

  • Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen – darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

  • Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner

  3. DoctoDay (vor Ort in einem unserer Offices - ca. 1,5 Stunden): verbringe Zeit mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen praxisnahen Einblick in die Aufgaben eines Account Executives bei Doctolib

  4. Eine Referenzprüfung

  5. Unser Angebot an Dich

 

Job Details

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

Customer Success Partner (EMEA)
description:
Customer Success Partner (London)

As a Customer Success Partner at CreatorIQ, you will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of Enterprise customers, helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through their creator marketing programs. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their goals and align them with CreatorIQ’s platform capabilities, driving long-term adoption, value realization, and program success.

 

You’ll build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders—both virtually and in person—and serve as a proactive partner throughout the customer lifecycle. Customer Success Partners are experts in the CreatorIQ platform, fluent in creator and influencer marketing strategy, and passionate about delivering measurable business impact.

 

You will own the health and retention of your portfolio and will be measured on outcomes including gross retention, platform adoption, customer health, and value realization.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of customers, aligning CreatorIQ’s capabilities to their business goals and driving measurable value.

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to executive stakeholders.

  • Drive platform adoption and customer success by understanding each customer’s strategy, analyzing engagement, and identifying opportunities to increase value.

  • Lead strategic engagements including success planning, business reviews, roadmap discussions, and in-person meetings as appropriate.

  • Own customer health and retention across your portfolio, proactively identifying risk and coordinating action plans to support long-term success.

  • Maintain strategic account plans that capture customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, risks, and growth opportunities.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Services, Support, and Product to deliver a cohesive customer experience and resolve needs effectively.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally while staying current on CreatorIQ capabilities and industry trends to bring relevant insights and best practices to customers.

 

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • Passionate about creator and influencer marketing, social media, and helping customers build successful programs.

  • 3+ years of experience in a strategic customer-facing role, ideally within influencer marketing, an agency, brand, SaaS, or marketing technology environment.

  • Proven ability to manage toward business KPIs, retention goals, customer health, and customer advocacy metrics.

  • Skilled at navigating customer organizations and building relationships across multiple levels, from daily users to executive sponsors.

  • Comfortable translating customer goals into actionable success strategies and measurable outcomes.

  • Able to use customer, adoption, and performance data to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories.

  • Strong strategic thinker who can also manage the day-to-day execution and follow-through required to move customer initiatives forward.

  • Confident leading structured customer engagements including success planning, business reviews, executive conversations, and roadmap discussions.

  • Highly organized and proactive, with the ability to effectively prioritize and manage a portfolio of customers with varying needs and levels of complexity.

  • Curious, solutions-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Collaborative and experienced working cross-functionally with teams such as Implementation, Support, Product, Services, Insights, and Sales.

  • Comfortable with customer success and productivity tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Notion, Jira, or similar platforms.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

  • Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you.

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

We know that benefits play a significant role in your overall compensation. We invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Strategic Partnerships Lead - UK
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

Rillet is hiring its first partnerships leader in the UK. You will kickstart our partner motion in the market from day one: choosing where to start, signing the first partners, and building results and momentum so we can staff up a team around you.

This is a founding, high-agency role that will span all three of Rillet's partner channels in the UK:

  • Accounting & Advisory: CPA, chartered accountancy, and ERP consulting firms that recommend and implement Rillet for their clients

  • Private Equity & Venture Capital: investors who back finance-led high growth companies and want to tool them with the best available technology

The Senior Director, Pricing Operations will lead the transformation of Sophos's SecOps pricing function: building a centralized team, a disciplined operating cadence, and an AI-assisted governance model that let pricing move at the pace of the market. This is a build role. The Director will design the target operating model, stand up the team and the cadence behind it, and give senior leadership a clear, early view of competitive and market shifts, with a strong dotted line into the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions connected across both businesses.


What You Will Do

The Sophos IR team is an elite group of incident responders that are engaged by organizations worldwide to respond to and neutralize cyber threats. Specializing in industry-standard forensic tools and Sophos technologies, the team provides comprehensive investigations, response actions, remediation guidance, and root cause analysis to combat a wide range of cybersecurity incidents.

At the culmination of each engagement, you will be responsible for producing an executive summary-style report, which will include a timeline of key events mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Development Engineer to help us in our mission by supporting in the development, manufacturing and testing of the Nyx Earth Propulsion systems. In order to qualify the propulsion systems a multitude of tests will be required spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hotfires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be designing test rigs to validate flight design, assembling and lastly performing the testing on the test rigs to provide critical data needed to validate simulation models.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Development Engineer, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design, development and testing activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase;

  • Define and maintain the test objectives and requirements

  • Establish and justify, together with the pressure and fluidic system engineers, the architecture and the design (P&ID, PBS, interfaces) of the models and test rigs

  • Design of thruster test rigs

  • Define and select components, parts and sensors and manage their procurement

  • Elaborate and maintain the schedule and cost, ensuring on-time and on-cost of the pressure system and the propellant feed system test rigs.

  • Create test procedures ensuring safe and efficient operation of all test rigs

During assembly and testing phase

  • Support on the testing and assembly of thrusters

  • Perform assembly, troubleshooting and commissioning of the test rigs

  • Perform test campaigns, analyzing in real-time the test parameters and the test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test report.

  • Support on updating and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Perform maintenance and upgrades of test rigs

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • Over 2 years of related experience in designing, building, and testing complex fluid systems.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in fluid dynamics

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Experience with CAD design

  • Experience using data acquisition equipment, as well as test instrumentation and control components.

  • Experience with the generation of test plans as well as planning and conducting development test campaigns.

  • Experience in cold flow test operations of pressurization and feed systems

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
description:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

title: Product & Operations Management Apprentice
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Back Market is the world’s leading refurbished electronics marketplace, with a team of 650 people powering operations across 18 countries and counting.

Our mission is simple: empowering people to consume tech more sustainably by offering a high-quality, accessible and more eco-friendly alternative to buying new electronics. Be part of an exciting and growing international adventure that is changing the way the world consumes tech.

We are looking for a curious, organized and proactive Product & Business Operations Apprentice to join our Partnerships team.

The Partnerships team works with telecom, retail and other strategic partners to make refurbished technology more accessible to customers. We manage a growing portfolio of partnerships, launch new commercial opportunities and continuously improve the customer journeys and operating processes that support them.

This apprenticeship is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, Business Operations, Partnerships, Analytics and Commercial Operations. You will help the team scale its operating model by taking ownership of structured recurring activities, supporting launches and experiments, and identifying opportunities to improve our processes.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Monitor partnership health by updating dashboards, reviewing customer journeys, tracking incidents and preparing portfolio summaries.

  • Contribute to new partnership features and drive continuous improvement by managing product partnership initiatives, documenting requirements, coordinating delivery and contributing to experiments.

  • Coordinate launch and QA activities, including test plans and launch-readiness updates.

  • Support business operations through reporting, basic analysis, meeting follow-ups, documentation and invoicing reconciliation.

  • Be an active part in onboarding new partners to Back Market.

  • Contribute to new partnership projects by researching potential partners, preparing benchmarks and helping improve or automate recurring processes.

TOOLS YOU’LL USE: ⚒️

Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Google Slides, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Tableau or other business intelligence tools, and internal Back Market tools.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are enrolled in a French higher-education programme that includes an apprenticeship contract.

  • You are looking for a multi-year apprenticeship, ideally in product management, business operations, partnerships, analytics, business, engineering or a related field.

  • You are fluent in both written and spoken French and English, as we are an international team. This is mandatory.

  • You are organized, rigorous and comfortable managing several topics at the same time.

  • You enjoy working with data, spreadsheets and recurring reports, and can identify trends or discrepancies.

  • You take ownership, ask good questions and follow through on commitments.

  • You are a clear and structured communicator who enjoys coordinating with different stakeholders.

  • You are curious and comfortable switching between detailed execution and a broader understanding of business objectives.

  • You are interested in product, partnerships, e-commerce, telecom, marketplaces or business operations.

  • You enjoy improving processes rather than simply repeating them.

  • You are comfortable learning new tools and working in an evolving environment.

  • You have a strong team spirit and enjoy collaborating with Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Operations and customer-facing teams.

Bonus points if:

  • You have previous experience in product management, business operations, project management, partnerships or analytics.

  • You have worked with dashboards, QA processes, experiments or reporting workflows.

  • You have used automation or no-code tools.

  • You have experience in e-commerce, telecom, retail or marketplace environments.

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed).

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • HR Interview with Campus Recruitment Manager

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your motivation, organization and analytical approach.

  • Team/Cultural fit interview with with stakeholders from tech and data.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction.

  • Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide.

  • Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites.

  • Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi.

Quelques repères :

  • Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres

  • 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion

  • 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record

Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail.

Le poste

Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir.

Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics.

Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros.

On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer.

Ce que tu vas faire

  • Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests.

  • Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final.

  • Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier.

  • Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut.

  • Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique.

  • Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement.

  • Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé.

Une personne, des agents IA

Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber.

L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent.

C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser.

L'équipe autour de toi

Chez Green-Got, l'acquisition est une boucle complète portée par des profils complémentaires :

  1. Awareness : l’équipe qui fait connaître Green-Got au plus grand nombre

  2. Acquisition haut de funnel : toi

  3. CRM et Product Growth : ceux qui transforment et activent les personnes que tu amènes

Tu travailles main dans la main avec le CRM, avec le Product Growth et avec l'équipe Wealth Management.

Tu es rattaché au Head of Growth, qui est là pour te mentorer, t'aider et te guider.
Notre Head of Growth, Clément Jaunault, fait de la growth depuis dix ans, de la legaltech au SaaS. Arrivé chez Green-Got avant le lancement, il l'a fait passer de 0 à 100 000 utilisateurs et de 0 à 300 M€ d'encours, et il mentore déjà de jeunes growth hors de l'entreprise.

Ton profil

Indispensable

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en acquisition, growth ou traffic management (tes side projects comptent)

  • Tu es un faiseur : tu livres, tu shippes, tu passes vite d'un sujet à l'autre

  • Tu es data driven. Tu as de l'instinct, mais tu valides tout avec la data.

  • Tu utilises l’IA au quotidien et tu as déjà construit des outils ou des automatisations avec.

  • Tu es autonome, débrouillard et problem solver : face à un problème, tu trouves une solution

  • Tu as un mindset business : tu raisonnes en chiffre d'affaires, pas en vanity metrics

  • Tu t'intéresses vraiment à la finance.

  • Tu es sensible aux enjeux d'écologie, de transition à l'échelle française et européenne, et de santé

  • Tu es créatif, proactif, organisé et rigoureux

  • Tu parles anglais

Ce qui nous fera vraiment craquer

  • Tu as déjà lancé tes propres projets : une boutique e-commerce, un site d'affiliation, des side projects. Tu as tenté des choses.

  • Tu viens d'agence, mais tu as des projets à côté et tu veux maintenant aller plus loin : un seul annonceur, beaucoup de budget, de vrais résultats à porter.

  • Tu as déjà travaillé dans la finance ou la fintech, et tu connais les règles de la communication sur les produits financiers.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour toi si…

  • Tu préfères concevoir la stratégie et laisser d'autres l'exécuter

  • Tu présentes tes résultats en clics, en impressions ou en leads sans te soucier du resultat final

  • Tu attends qu'on te dise quoi faire et quoi tester

Ce qu'on t'offre

  • Un package entre 52 et 62 k€ (fixe + variable) et des BSPCE

description:

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 
 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 
 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 
 

Profil recherché

 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)

 
 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Notre vision

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 
 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 
 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 
 

Profil recherché

 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

title: Account Executive - Dutch
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client operates in the real estate and home improvement industry, specialising in bathroom remodelling. They help homeowners transform their bathrooms through tailored renovation solutions. They are looking for an experienced Dutch-speaking High-Ticket Sales Closer to join their sales team and convert qualified prospects into customers.

Working directly with prospective customers through video sales calls, you'll be responsible for building rapport, understanding customer needs, handling objections, and closing high-value deals. This is an opportunity for a confident sales professional who knows how to create trust, communicate value, and consistently deliver results in a performance-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct approximately 4–5 video sales calls per day with qualified prospects who have booked and attended their appointments
  • Handle a target of approximately 45 qualified showed sales calls per month
  • Convert qualified prospects into customers, targeting an average of 1–2 direct sales per day
  • Build strong relationships with prospective customers through excellent communication, active listening, and rapport-building techniques
  • Use mirroring techniques and an adaptable tone of voice to establish trust and connect with different customer personalities
  • Understand customer requirements, present suitable solutions, and communicate the value of bathroom remodelling services
  • Handle objections confidently and guide prospects through the decision-making process
  • Apply culturally sensitive communication and closing techniques when engaging with Dutch-speaking customers
  • Maintain accurate sales activity and follow-ups using the company's systems
  • Work towards revenue generation targets, with a reference target of 400K

Requirements

  • Fluent in both Dutch and English (essential)
  • Proven experience in sales, particularly cold calling and direct sales
  • Demonstrable high-ticket sales and closing experience
  • Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and a confident, engaging tone of voice
  • Strong rapport-building, active listening, and mirroring skills
  • Ability to adapt communication and closing techniques to different customer personalities and cultural backgrounds
  • Comfortable conducting video sales calls and working towards daily sales and revenue targets
  • Reliable, organised, and able to communicate availability consistently
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Slack, and Google Meet

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in real estate or property-related sales
  • Experience in construction, home improvement, or bathroom remodelling
  • Experience selling high-value renovation or home improvement services

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

title: Account Executive - Mid-market - €60–80K + BSPCE
description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch.

We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

  • Make your first prospecting calls, demos, and initial sales conversations

  • Close your first simple deals independently.

3 months:

  • Build a stable pipeline, with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages

  • Improve our call scripts and email sequences

  • Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments

  • Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap

  • Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification

6-12 months:

  • Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

  • Contribute to structuring our sales playbook

  • Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline

  • Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

  • Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

  • Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle

  • Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers

  • Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

  • Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature)

Make the engine better

  • Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

  • Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the liberal segment

  • Deal size from 15K to 30K

  • 1 month sale cycle

  • ICP : group of independent practitioners

This role is for you if

The prerequisites:

  • You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

  • You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy.

  • You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews:

  • Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

  • Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

  • Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience

  • Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

  • Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

  • Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

  • Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

  • Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

  • You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

  • You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

  1. Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

  3. Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

  4. Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • Opening the US market

The problem

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own

  • The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

  • The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

  • The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

  • The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

  • You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

  • You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

  • Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

  • You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English.

Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move.

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production.

  • First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve.

  • First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

  • 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own.

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.
